review.reviewer: Implementation owner following independent exact-head review
review.decision: Exercise ordinary cross-tab credential replacement and removal with two stored profiles.
review.notes: Use a disposable browser origin. Create real drafts and turn bookmarks using each synthetic identity. Restore both profiles after another tab changes the credential. Keep the existing explicit revocation tests.

cases.description: Cross-tab pairing preserves each identity's saved input and bookmarks
cases.setup: Two same-origin pages, two synthetic identities and a conversation with bookmarkable turns.
cases.action: Use the composer and bookmark controls under each identity, switch from the other tab, remove the credential, then reconnect and reload.
cases.expected: The prior view retires. Each identity restores its own draft and marked turn. The unpaired view offers pairing and cannot show private data.
